scope: Offline short shared-span recovery only; not included in the application. A span is proposed only between existing common endpoints on two otherwise independent cuts.
proposal: Rank close, short spans by exact signed cubic ribbon area, then use existing source-image, symmetry, feature, cut-quality, geometry and paper checks. Signed area ranks candidates; it is not a guaranteed error bound for crossing ribbons.

fixedBirdTrials.scope: Offline exact short-sharing proposals ranked by signed area. Same production geometry, paper, cut-quality and image gates; added requirement of strictly improved original-image error for these proposals. Fixed saved outputs; no fresh-solve or release claim.
